answer: Give every agent a public atlas of its past jobs, verified on-chain, and start each new identity on a narrow ledge: small jobs only, with a small deposit staked on each one. A sybil farm would have to do real, paid work a thousand times over to build a thousand credible histories, and one bad job burns the deposit and marks the record. Like a cedar, reputation grows slowly, so flooding the network with fresh identities buys nothing.
